title: Kernel, exactness, and epimorphism components of Artin–Schreier data
statement: Given the sectionwise Artin–Schreier data and its formulas, the associated short complex is exact, its first map is mono, and its second map is epi.

source.place: Kernel and epimorphism part of the Artin–Schreier argument

proof.text: Use [lem-sc-as-kernel-sections] to obtain sectionwise injectivity of iota and lifts of roots. The section formula for wp turns a wp-killed section into a root. Choose these unique lifts for each component of a map killed by wp. Injectivity makes the component lifts additive and natural, and makes them unique. This constructs the universal property IsLimit (KernelFork.ofι iota hzero). ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel and mono_of_isLimit_fork give exactness and monicity.

Proved directly in Lean: the prime field ULift (ZMod p) maps to the global sections of an etale object U via its structural map to Spec k. Base-change the proved upstream AffineSpace.surjective_artinSchreierMap along U -> Spec ULift (ZMod p), and use AffineSpace.etale_artinSchreierMap, since p vanishes on U. Pull this finite etale surjective Artin–Schreier map back along the affine-line section with coordinate a_U(x). The pulled-back coordinate is a solution y^p-y=g^*a_U(x). Transfer y through a_V.symm. The formulas hwp and hrestr show that the singleton covering sieve is contained in the image sieve of wp. Sheaf.epi_of_isLocallySurjective gives epimorphicity. These upstream lemmas are already proved tools; no parent Artin–Schreier sheaf-sequence theorem is used.

proof_origin.place: Kernel identification from first sentence, local surjectivity from Artin–Schreier covers; C1 proves the categorical assembly and covers with upstream affine-space lemmas

lean.statement:
theorem artinSchreier_data_exact_components
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    {C : Scheme.{u}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f]
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p)
    (G : Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hG : G ≅ (sheafCompose C.smallEtaleTopology
      AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj
        (Scheme.Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf (Scheme.Modules.unitObj C)))
    (a : ∀ U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ, G.obj.obj U ≃+ Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))
    (wp : G ⟶ G) (iota : C.constantZMod p ⟶ G) (hzero : iota ≫ wp = 0)
    (hrestr : ∀ (U V : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (g : U ⟶ V) (x : G.obj.obj U),
      a V (G.obj.map g x) = g.unop.left.appTop (a U x))
    (hwp : ∀ (U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : G.obj.obj U),
      a U (wp.hom.app U x) = (a U x) ^ p - a U x)
    (hiota : ∀ (U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (c : ZMod p),
      a U (iota.hom.app U
        ((toSheafify C.smallEtaleTopology
          ((Functor.const C.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod p))))).app U (ULift.up c))) =
        (c.val : Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))) :
    (ShortComplex.mk iota wp hzero).Exact ∧
      Mono iota ∧ Epi wp
